build_get_cpus: build a function call to get_cpus that returns 50 percent of available CPUs on the machine
build_get_gpus_all: build a function call to get_gpus that returns all available GPUs on the machine
build_get_gpus_memory_filter: build a function call to get_gpus that filters GPUs by minimum available memory in gigabytes
build_get_gpus_percentage_filter: build a function call to get_gpus that filters GPUs by minimum available memory percentage of total
build_get_gpus_max_limit: build a function call to get_gpus that limits the returned GPU list to a maximum number of devices
